She holds a red focus mitt with her left hand to catch a punch, her expression focused. The woman in the white sports bra (R2) stands on the right, back partially to the camera, extending her right arm to land a punch with her black boxing glove directly onto the red mitt. Cool overhead gym lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows.
